que_estudiar: Where Curiosity landed on 6 Aug 2012. The landing rockets blew away the soil at Goulburn and exposed the bedrock underneath: a free look below the dust.

en.que: Where Curiosity landed on 6 Aug 2012. The landing rockets blew away the soil at Goulburn and exposed the bedrock underneath: a free look below the dust.

es.que: Donde aterrizó Curiosity el 6 de agosto de 2012. Los cohetes de aterrizaje barrieron el suelo en Goulburn y dejaron ver la roca de abajo: una mirada gratis debajo del polvo.

ubicacion: Curiosity position on sol 0 (NASA/JPL MSL waypoints)

que_estudiar: Conglomerate with rounded pebbles stuck together. Pebbles only get round by rolling in water: proof of an old stream, about ankle to hip deep.

en.que: Conglomerate with rounded pebbles stuck together. Pebbles only get round by rolling in water: proof of an old stream, about ankle to hip deep.

es.que: Conglomerado con piedras redondeadas pegadas. Las piedras solo se redondean rodando en agua: prueba de un arroyo antiguo, de la profundidad del tobillo a la cadera.
es.inst: Fotos de cerca, química por láser (como ChemCam)

ubicacion: Curiosity position on sol 27 (NASA/JPL MSL waypoints)

que_estudiar: A tilted slab of ancient streambed gravel. Together with Link it was the first evidence of flowing water seen by Curiosity.

en.que: A tilted slab of ancient streambed gravel. Together with Link it was the first evidence of flowing water seen by Curiosity.

es.que: Una losa inclinada de grava de un antiguo cauce. Junto con Link fue la primera prueba de agua corriendo que vio Curiosity.
es.inst: Fotos de cerca, química por rayos X (como APXS)

ubicacion: Curiosity position on sol 39 (NASA/JPL MSL waypoints)

que_estudiar: A drift of wind-blown sand where Curiosity used its scoop for the first time. First X-ray diffraction of Martian soil (17 Oct 2012). Heating the soil released water.
instrumento: Scoop, X-ray diffraction (like CheMin), oven analysis (like SAM)

en.que: A drift of wind-blown sand where Curiosity used its scoop for the first time. First X-ray diffraction of Martian soil (17 Oct 2012). Heating the soil released water.
en.inst: Scoop, X-ray diffraction (like CheMin), oven analysis (like SAM)

es.que: Un montón de arena traída por el viento donde Curiosity usó su pala por primera vez. Primera difracción de rayos X de suelo marciano (17 de octubre de 2012). Al calentar el suelo salió agua.
es.inst: Pala, difracción de rayos X (como CheMin), horno de análisis (como SAM)

ubicacion: Curiosity position on sol 60 (NASA/JPL MSL waypoints)

que_estudiar: Sandstone with cross-bedding: tilted layers that form when water flows over sand. Shows the direction the ancient river ran.

en.que: Sandstone with cross-bedding: tilted layers that form when water flows over sand. Shows the direction the ancient river ran.

es.que: Arenisca con capas cruzadas: capas inclinadas que se forman cuando el agua corre sobre la arena. Muestra hacia dónde corría el río antiguo.

ubicacion: Curiosity position on sol 120 (NASA/JPL MSL waypoints)

que_estudiar: The first two rocks ever drilled on Mars, 3 m apart. Sheepbed mudstone from an old lake with clay minerals: NASA announced in March 2013 that conditions here were once suitable for microbial life. Cumberland also gave the first rock age measured on another planet (about 4 billion years).
instrumento: Drill, X-ray diffraction (like CheMin), oven analysis (like SAM)

en.que: The first two rocks ever drilled on Mars, 3 m apart. Sheepbed mudstone from an old lake with clay minerals: NASA announced in March 2013 that conditions here were once suitable for microbial life. Cumberland also gave the first rock age measured on another planet (about 4 billion years).
en.inst: Drill, X-ray diffraction (like CheMin), oven analysis (like SAM)

es.que: Las dos primeras rocas perforadas en Marte, a 3 m una de otra. Lodolita Sheepbed de un lago antiguo, con arcillas: NASA anunció en marzo de 2013 que aquí hubo condiciones aptas para vida microbiana. Cumberland además dio la primera edad de una roca medida en otro planeta (unos 4 mil millones de años).
es.inst: Taladro, difracción de rayos X (como CheMin), horno de análisis (como SAM)

ubicacion: Curiosity position on sol 182 (NASA/JPL MSL waypoints)

que_estudiar: First stop on the drive to Mount Sharp: pebbly sandstone from streams, studied to compare with Yellowknife Bay.

en.que: First stop on the drive to Mount Sharp: pebbly sandstone from streams, studied to compare with Yellowknife Bay.

es.que: Primera parada del camino al Monte Sharp: arenisca con piedras de arroyo, estudiada para compararla con Yellowknife Bay.
es.inst: Fotos de cerca, química por rayos X (como APXS)

ubicacion: Curiosity position on sol 395 (NASA/JPL MSL waypoints)
